root.label: FAA launches Envy of the World air traffic control modernization

events.label: FAA launches Envy of the World air traffic control modernization

slots.name: project budget
slots.sentence: Just over a year ago, the Federal Aviation Administration kickstarted an effort to build an “Envy of the World” air traffic control network to the tune of $12.5 billion.

slots.name: wires replaced
slots.sentence: To date, roughly two-thirds of aging copper wires have been replaced by fiber optic cables or wireless technology, helping pilots communicate more effectively with controllers on the ground.

slots.name: systems installed
slots.sentence: Meanwhile, dozens of new surface-awareness systems have been installed, giving personnel a clearer picture of aircraft and vehicles moving across runways and taxiways.

slots.name: deployment status
slots.sentence: The tech is currently being debuted at airports in the D.C.-area with hopes that it can be extended to hubs nationwide.

slots.name: phase status
slots.sentence: The FAA has warned that it is “already starting to delay phase two and phase three because of lack of funding.”
